Field manual

  1. Select a formation. Attack immediately or move once to a blue hex.
  2. Tap an unreachable hex or Deselect to cancel. Tap any enemy to inspect its stats.
  3. Squads lose visible models as members fall. Healers restore allied health instead of attacking.
  4. Higher ground adds range and defense. Ridges and high tiles can block line of sight.
  5. The Sunwell requires two uncontested end-of-round holds.
